import json, signal, sys
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs, urlencode
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.common.keys import Keys
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait, Select
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
s = json.loads(sys.argv[1]); driver = None
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, lambda *args: (_ for _ in ()).throw(TimeoutError('Saved-filter view browser exceeded 25 seconds'))); signal.alarm(25)
try:
    options = webdriver.ChromeOptions(); options.binary_location = '/usr/bin/chromium'
    options.set_capability('goog:loggingPrefs', {'browser': 'ALL'})
    for flag in ['--headless=new', '--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', '--window-size=1440,1400']: options.add_argument(flag)
    driver = webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'), options=options); driver.set_page_load_timeout(8); wait = WebDriverWait(driver, 6)
    driver.get(s['url']); name, value = s['cookie'].split('=', 1); driver.add_cookie({'name': name, 'value': value, 'path': '/'})
    driver.execute_cdp_cmd('Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument', {'source': """
      window.__nativeFetch=fetch.bind(window);window.__requests=[];window.__held=[];
      window.fetch=(url,options={})=>{
        const parsed=new URL(url,location.href),method=options.method||'GET';
        const entry={url:String(url),path:parsed.pathname,method,hasSignal:Boolean(options.signal)};
        window.__requests.push(entry);
        const hold=window.__hold&&window.__hold.path===parsed.pathname&&window.__hold.method===method&&(!window.__hold.q||parsed.searchParams.get('q')===window.__hold.q);
        if(hold)window.__hold=null;
        return window.__nativeFetch(url,options).then(async response=>{
          entry.status=response.status;if(!hold)return response;
          const bytes=await response.arrayBuffer();return new Promise(resolve=>window.__held.push({release:()=>resolve(new Response(bytes,{status:response.status,headers:response.headers}))}));
        });
      };
    """})
    def text(): return driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text
    def location(): return driver.execute_script('return location.hash.slice(1)')
    def button(label, parent=None):
        xpath = './/button[normalize-space()="' + label + '"]' if parent else '//main//button[normalize-space()="' + label + '"]'
        return wait.until(lambda d: (parent or d).find_element(By.XPATH, xpath) if (parent or d).find_element(By.XPATH, xpath).is_enabled() else False)
    def write(selector, value):
        field = wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, selector))); field.send_keys(Keys.CONTROL, 'a', Keys.NULL, Keys.BACKSPACE)
        if value: field.send_keys(value)
        return field
    def names(): return [el.text for el in driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.saved-filters h2 a')]
    def page(count): return wait.until(lambda d: len(names()) == count and 'Showing the applied view from this URL.' in text())
    def view_form(): return driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'form[aria-label="Saved-filter view"]')
    def apply(): button('Apply view').click()
    def fields():
        form = view_form()
        return {'q': form.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'input').get_attribute('value'), 'visibility': form.find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, 'select')[0].get_attribute('value'), 'teamId': form.find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, 'select')[1].get_attribute('value'), 'owned': form.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'input[type=checkbox]').is_selected()}
    def query(): return parse_qs(location().partition('?')[2])
    def api(method, path, body=None):
        return driver.execute_async_script("const [method,path,body,done]=arguments;window.__nativeFetch('/api/v1'+path,{method,headers:{'content-type':'application/json','X-Crew-Request':'1'},body:body==null?undefined:JSON.stringify(body)}).then(async r=>done({status:r.status,data:await r.json()})).catch(e=>done({error:e.message}))", method, path, body)
    def card(name): return wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.XPATH, '//ul[@class="saved-filters"]/li[.//h2/a[normalize-space()="' + name + '"]]')))
    def hold(method, path, q=None): driver.execute_script('window.__hold={method:arguments[0],path:arguments[1],q:arguments[2]};window.__held=[]', method, '/api/v1' + path, q)
    def held(): wait.until(lambda d: d.execute_script('return window.__held.length') == 1)
    def release(): driver.execute_async_script('const done=arguments[0];window.__held.splice(0).forEach(item=>item.release());requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(done))')
    def details(): wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'article[aria-label="Saved filter details"]')))
    def return_link(): return driver.find_element(By.LINK_TEXT, 'Saved filters')
    def current_later():
        page(25); button('Next').click(); page(5)
        assert query().get('cursor') and 'Later page' in text()
        return location(), names()
    initial = '/filters?' + urlencode({'orgId': s['orgId'], 'q': 'needle', 'visibility': 'team', 'teamId': s['teamId'], 'owned': 'true'})
    driver.get(s['url'] + '/?saved-view-proof=' + s['mode'] + '#' + initial)
    page(25)
    if s['mode'] == 'view':
        assert fields() == {'q': 'needle', 'visibility': 'team', 'teamId': s['teamId'], 'owned': True}
        history_length = driver.execute_script('return history.length'); before = location()
        write('form[aria-label="Saved-filter view"] input', 'unsent lookup')
        assert location() == before and driver.execute_script('return history.length') == history_length
        assert 'View changes are not applied.' in text() and len(names()) == 25
        write('form[aria-label="Saved-filter view"] input', 'needle'); apply(); page(25)
        later, later_names = current_later()
        driver.back(); wait.until(lambda d: not query().get('cursor')); page(25)
        driver.forward(); wait.until(lambda d: location() == later); page(5); assert names() == later_names
        driver.refresh(); page(5); assert location() == later and names() == later_names
        previous = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//main//button[normalize-space()="Previous"]')
        assert not previous.is_enabled() and 'previous page is unavailable' in text()
        button('Refresh filters').click(); page(5); assert location() == later and names() == later_names
        button('Reset view').click(); wait.until(lambda d: query() == {'orgId': [s['orgId']]}); page(25)
        assert fields() == {'q': '', 'visibility': 'all', 'teamId': '', 'owned': False}
        driver.back(); wait.until(lambda d: location() == later); page(5); assert fields()['q'] == 'needle'
        driver.get(s['url'] + '/?direct-later=1#' + later); page(5); assert names() == later_names
        button('First page').click(); wait.until(lambda d: not query().get('cursor')); page(25)
        assert set(query()) <= {'orgId', 'q', 'visibility', 'teamId', 'owned', 'cursor'}
        button('Reset view').click(); page(25); reset_location = location()
        write('form[aria-label="Saved-filter view"] input', 'needle')
        Select(view_form().find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, 'select')[0]).select_by_value('team')
        Select(view_form().find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, 'select')[1]).select_by_value(s['teamId'])
        view_form().find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'input[type=checkbox]').click()
        assert location() == reset_location
        apply(); page(25)
        assert query() == {'orgId': [s['orgId']], 'q': ['needle'], 'visibility': ['team'], 'teamId': [s['teamId']], 'owned': ['true']}
        driver.back(); wait.until(lambda d: location() == reset_location); page(25); assert fields()['q'] == ''
        driver.forward(); wait.until(lambda d: query().get('owned') == ['true']); page(25); assert fields()['q'] == 'needle'
        print(json.dumps({'ok': True, 'mode': s['mode'], 'typedWithoutHistory': True, 'laterView': later, 'laterNames': later_names, 'reloadSamePage': True, 'nativeBackForward': True, 'resetAndFirstPage': True, 'honestPrevious': True}))
    elif s['mode'] == 'return':
        later, later_names = current_later(); selected = later_names[0]
        card(selected).find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'h2 a').click(); details()
        source_path = location().partition('?')[0]
        assert query()['returnTo'] == [later]
        button('Run filter').click(); wait.until(lambda d: '1 issues found' in text())
        assert return_link().get_attribute('href').partition('#')[2] == later
        button('Edit saved filter').click(); write('.filter-form textarea', 'needle edited description'); button('Save filter').click()
        wait.until(lambda d: 'Saved “' + selected + '”.' in text())
        assert api('GET', source_path)['data']['filter']['description'] == 'needle edited description'
        assert return_link().get_attribute('href').partition('#')[2] == later
        button('Create personal copy').click(); write('.filter-form input', 'Personal return copy'); button('Save filter').click()
        wait.until(lambda d: d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'h1').text == 'Personal return copy')
        copy_path = location().partition('?')[0]
        assert copy_path != source_path and query()['returnTo'] == [later]
        assert api('GET', copy_path)['data']['filter']['visibility'] == 'personal'
        button('Edit saved filter').click(); write('.filter-form input', 'Unsaved return copy')
        return_link().click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).dismiss()
        assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form input').get_attribute('value') == 'Unsaved return copy'
        return_link().click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept()
        wait.until(lambda d: location() == later and 'Showing the applied view from this URL.' in text())
        assert fields() == {'q': 'needle', 'visibility': 'team', 'teamId': s['teamId'], 'owned': True}
        assert query()['cursor'] == parse_qs(later.partition('?')[2])['cursor']
        assert 'previous page is unavailable' in text()
        unsafe = ['https://example.test/filters', '/filters/detail', '/filters?returnTo=%2Ffilters', '/filters?owned=maybe', '/filters?orgId=%GG']
        for target in unsafe:
            driver.get(s['url'] + '/?bad-return=1#' + source_path + '?' + urlencode({'returnTo': target})); details()
            wait.until(lambda d: 'Ignored invalid saved-filter return view.' in text())
            href = return_link().get_attribute('href')
            assert urlparse(href).netloc == urlparse(s['url']).netloc
            assert href.partition('#')[2] == '/filters?orgId=' + s['orgId']
        return_link().click(); wait.until(lambda d: location() == '/filters?orgId=' + s['orgId']); page(25)
        print(json.dumps({'ok': True, 'mode': s['mode'], 'selectedView': later, 'currentRun': True, 'editReturnedView': True, 'copyReturnedView': True, 'invalidReturnsRejected': unsafe}))
    else:
        before = location(); button('Create saved filter').click(); write('.filter-form input', 'Dirty local view draft')
        write('form[aria-label="Saved-filter view"] input', 'background'); apply(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).dismiss()
        assert location() == before and driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form input').get_attribute('value') == 'Dirty local view draft'
        apply(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept(); page(0); assert not names() and fields()['visibility'] == 'team'
        # The initial team view still applies, so deliberately reset before testing the personal view.
        button('Reset view').click(); page(25)
        write('form[aria-label="Saved-filter view"] input', 'background'); apply(); page(1)
        button('Create saved filter').click(); write('.filter-form input', 'Dirty reset draft')
        button('Reset view').click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).dismiss(); assert 'Dirty reset draft' == driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form input').get_attribute('value')
        button('Reset view').click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept(); page(25)
        hold('GET', '/filters', 'needle'); write('form[aria-label="Saved-filter view"] input', 'needle'); apply(); held()
        assert not names()
        write('form[aria-label="Saved-filter view"] input', 'background'); apply(); page(1); release()
        assert names() == ['Background personal filter'] and fields()['q'] == 'background'
        hold('GET', '/filters/' + s['otherId']); button('Edit', card('Background personal filter')).click(); held()
        write('form[aria-label="Saved-filter view"] input', 'needle'); apply(); page(25); release()
        assert not driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form')
        button('Create saved filter').click(); write('.filter-form input', 'Abandoned URL create')
        wait.until(lambda d: d.execute_script('return document.querySelector(".filter-form").checkValidity()') and '11 suggestions available' in d.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form').text)
        hold('POST', '/filters'); button('Save filter').click(); held()
        posts = driver.execute_script('return window.__requests.filter(item=>item.path==="/api/v1/filters"&&item.method==="POST")')
        assert len(posts) == 1 and posts[0]['status'] == 201 and posts[0]['hasSignal']
        driver.back(); page(1); release()
        assert names() == ['Background personal filter'] and not driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form')
        assert 'Saved “Abandoned URL create”.' not in text()
        assert len(api('GET', '/filters?' + urlencode({'orgId': s['orgId'], 'q': 'Abandoned URL create'}))['data']['items']) == 1
        print(json.dumps({'ok': True, 'mode': s['mode'], 'dirtyApplyDeclineConfirm': True, 'dirtyResetDeclineConfirm': True, 'lateListSuppressed': True, 'lateEditorSuppressed': True, 'nativeBackAbandonedSave': True, 'publishedCreateRetained': True, 'postCount': len(posts)}))
except Exception:
    if driver:
        print(json.dumps({'body': driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text, 'url': driver.current_url, 'requests': driver.execute_script('return window.__requests'), 'held': driver.execute_script('return window.__held.length'), 'logs': driver.get_log('browser')}), file=sys.stderr)
    raise
finally:
    signal.alarm(0)
    if driver: driver.quit()
